notes:
- Caves: a second stairwell in the Laboratory leads down a full flight (6.4 m) into a cave system of 4 more
  areas: Caverns, Cave Tunnels and a Flooded Grotto. Rough rock walls, ceilings and floors, boulders,
  stalagmites and stalactites, outcrops breaking up the walls, puddles, and glowing fungus as the only light.
  Bring a flashlight.
- No windows down there either: zombies have to follow you down the stairs. Wall buys, perk machines, the box and
  intel files can turn up in the caves too.
- Fixed (v0.61): intel files upstairs had their pedestal buried in the floor below, and the upper rooms'
  walls were only tiled near the floor. Both line up properly now.
